    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    CameraManager
    Tracks camera position and zoom, then applies the view transform to the game canvas.
    Conveyor
    A transport machine that moves its currently held Item one grid cell in the direction it is facing.
    Direction
    Cardinal directions for machine facing and neighbor lookup.
    Dropper
    Machine that creates a specific ItemType when empty, then moves items forward like a Conveyor.
    Furnace
    Machine that converts held items into money by depositing their value into a PlayerBank.
    GameConstants
    Shared constants used across the UI layer.
    GameController
    Main JavaFX controller that wires together the grid, shop, input, placement, rendering, audio, and game-loop systems.
    GameLoopManager
    Owns the two game loops: 1.
    GameRenderer
    Handles the visual rendering of the game state onto the JavaFX Canvas.
    GridSystem
    Fixed-size grid that stores machines, manages placement, and advances item movement during each simulation tick.
    InputHandler
    Processes keyboard and scroll events, triggering UI toggles, build modes, and tracking active keys for continuous camera movement.
    InventoryUIBuilder
    Builds and manages the tabbed bottom inventory bar.
    Item
    Item with a type and mutable monetary value.
    ItemType
    Types of items that can be produced, moved, upgraded, and sold.
    Launcher
    Launcher for the game.
    Machine
    Base class for grid machines that face a direction and can hold one item.
    MachineCategory
    Shop and UI grouping categories for machine types.
    MachineType
    Defines the available machine blueprints, including their cost, UI metadata, category, and factory logic for creating placed machines.
    Main
    The primary entry point for the JavaFX application.
    OutgoingTransfer
    A single-tick intent to move an item from one grid cell to another.
    PlacementManager
    Manages the interactive placement and removal of machines on the game grid.
    PlacementMode
    Build or remove mode.
    PlayerBank
    Stores and updates the player's currency balance.
    ShopManager
    Manages the player's economy and inventory state.
    ShopUIBuilder
    Stateless builder that populates a TabPane with shop buttons.
    SoundEffect
    Sound effects used by UI and gameplay actions.
    SoundManager
    Centralised audio manager.
    StartMenuController
    Controls the main start menu UI.
    Tickable
    Simulation participant that receives periodic ticks.
    Upgrader
    Conveyor that multiplies an item's value when it accepts the item.
